title: Optically-biased Rydberg microwave receiver enabled by hybrid nonlinear interferometry
abstract: All-optical readout approach maintaining fully optical operation while achieving 35 dB improvement in SNR over conventional EIT readout. Reports sensitivity of ~176 nV/cm/sqrt(Hz). Uses optical bias field to replace local oscillator, enabling homodyne-like detection without RF LO. Published Nature Communications 2025.
key_claims: 35 dB SNR improvement over standard EIT readout
Fully optical operation - no RF local oscillator required
Optical bias field enables homodyne-equivalent detection
hardware_used: Rb vapor cell with optical bias field
